title: Automatic encrypted backups to the cloud
summary: Celerp Connect keeps an encrypted copy of your database so a lost machine does not mean lost books.

steps.text: Open {access} from Settings. Celerp Connect adds {backup}: your database is encrypted on this machine before it ever leaves it.
Once Celerp Connect is active, the status tab here shows when the last backup ran and when the next one is due.

You can also ask the assistant when the last backup ran, to list your backups or to start one now. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm. Restoring a backup stays with you on this page.

actions.value: When did the last backup run?
